abstract: Oversees grid interconnection stability, substation power factor standards, and municipal civil interfaces
system_message:
You are the Municipal utility liaison (UTIL), responsible for overseeing grid interconnection stability, substation power factor standards, and municipal civil interfaces across industrial wastewater nutrient recovery concession proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Stormwater surge retention（DRAIN）
information_points.content:
UTIL-DRAIN-R4V：Hydraulic stormwater simulation data for a ten-year design storm event across site hardstanding areas shows that the Membrane Aerated Biofilm Reactor Plan features a stormwater surge attenuation capacity of 2200 m3 across its dedicated retention basin buffering volume.
UTIL-DRAIN-TUX：Based on the hydraulic stormwater simulation for a ten-year design storm event across site hardstanding areas, the Struvite Precipitation Crystallization Plan provides a stormwater surge attenuation capacity of 1500 m3 in total dedicated retention basin buffering volume.
UTIL-DRAIN-0S4：The hydraulic stormwater simulation indicates that the Thermal Pyrolysis Biochar Recovery Plan provides a stormwater surge attenuation capacity of 3000 m3 of dedicated retention basin buffering volume for a ten-year design storm event across site hardstanding areas.

information_points.title: Oversees grid interconnection stability, substation power factor standards, and municipal civil interfaces（GRID）
information_points.content:
UTIL-GRID-DEE：According to the electrical interconnection compliance evaluation for the dedicated 20 kV industrial park distribution substation feeder, the Struvite Precipitation Crystallization Plan is certified as municipal grid power factor compliant, maintaining an operating power factor above 0.95 lagging without harmonic distortion.
UTIL-GRID-M8S：For the Membrane Aerated Biofilm Reactor Plan, the electrical interconnection review for the dedicated 20 kV industrial park distribution substation feeder confirms that the facility is not municipal grid power factor compliant, failing to verify an operating power factor above 0.95 lagging without harmonic distortion.
UTIL-GRID-78J：The Thermal Pyrolysis Biochar Recovery Plan satisfies municipal grid power factor compliance on the dedicated 20 kV industrial park distribution substation feeder, verifying that its operating power factor remains above 0.95 lagging without harmonic distortion.
